description: Bridge-generated from schemas/uml-foundation.ts — a normalisation of schemas-lib src/schemas/domains/uml (UML 2.5.1). Fourteen metaclasses as primitives (Package, Model, Class, Interface, DataType, PrimitiveType, Enumeration, EnumerationLiteral, Property, Operation, Parameter, Association, Constraint, Comment) and twelve typed edges for ownership, typing, generalisation, realisation, dependency, association ends, annotation and constraint.
